process.heading: Our SEO Process
process.subtitle: A transparent, data-driven SEO methodology that delivers consistent ranking improvements and organic growth month after month.

steps.title: SEO Audit & Competitor Analysis
steps.description: We start with a comprehensive technical SEO audit of your website — identifying crawl errors, page speed issues, broken links, duplicate content, and on-page gaps. We also benchmark your top 5 competitors to find ranking opportunities.

steps.title: Keyword Research & Strategy
steps.description: We identify high-value, intent-driven keywords your target audience is searching — balancing search volume, competition, and business relevance to build a keyword strategy that drives qualified traffic, not just rankings.

steps.title: On-Page SEO Optimization
steps.description: We optimize every page on your website — title tags, meta descriptions, headings, content structure, internal linking, image alt text, and schema markup — to ensure Google fully understands and ranks your content.

steps.title: Technical SEO & Site Speed
steps.description: We fix all technical issues that prevent Google from properly crawling and indexing your website — improving site speed, mobile-friendliness, Core Web Vitals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and HTTPS security.

steps.title: Content & Authority Building
steps.description: We create SEO-optimized blog content, landing pages, and resource articles that attract links and rank for informational keywords — building topical authority that signals expertise to Google in your industry.

steps.title: Reporting & Ongoing Optimization
steps.description: Every month we deliver a clear ranking and traffic report — showing keyword position changes, organic traffic growth, and conversion improvements. We continuously refine our strategy based on data and algorithm updates.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: SEO typically takes 3–6 months to show significant ranking improvements, with major traffic and lead growth visible by month 6–12. Highly competitive industries may take longer. We provide monthly progress reports so you can track growth throughout.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Page 1 Google rankings?
faqs.answer: No ethical SEO agency can guarantee specific rankings — Google's algorithm is constantly evolving. However, we have a proven track record of achieving Page 1 rankings for 150+ keywords across competitive industries, and we back our work with transparent monthly reporting.

faqs.question: What is included in your monthly SEO service?
faqs.answer: Our monthly SEO retainer includes keyword tracking, on-page optimizations, technical fixes, content creation, link building, Google Search Console monitoring, and a detailed monthly performance report.

faqs.question: Do you work on both new and existing websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide SEO services for both new websites (building authority from scratch) and existing websites (auditing, fixing issues, and scaling rankings). We start with a comprehensive audit regardless.

faqs.question: Will my rankings drop if I stop SEO?
faqs.answer: Rankings built through strong SEO are durable, but they can gradually decline without ongoing optimization as competitors continue investing. We recommend viewing SEO as a continuous investment for sustained market leadership.
